# Top 10 EV-Friendly Hotels in Hong Kong: Best Stays with EV Charging 2026

**Last updated: May 27, 2026**

Hong Kong's EV adoption rate has surged past 40% of new car registrations in 2026, making it one of the fastest-adopting EV markets in Asia outside mainland China. With the HKSAR government's roadmap targeting 500,000 EVs on the road by 2030 — and a ban on new ICE vehicle registrations approaching — finding hotels with reliable EV charging is becoming essential for both business and leisure travellers.

Hong Kong presents unique challenges for EV owners: limited space in tightly packed urban districts, older buildings with insufficient electrical capacity, and the sheer vertical density of hotels. Unlike Thailand or Malaysia where surface parking with chargers is common, HK hotels must retrofit charging into cramped basement car parks — and the best ones have done it exceptionally well.

We've ranked Hong Kong's top 10 EV-friendly hotels based on charger availability, charging speed, reliability, pricing, location, and overall guest experience. Whether you're driving a Tesla Model 3 from Central to Repulse Bay, commuting from the New Territories, or flying in to rent an EV for business, these hotels will keep your battery topped up.

## Detailed Rankings

### 1. The Ritz-Carlton Hong Kong ⭐ 9.5/10

**Location:** West Kowloon (ICC Tower, 102nd floor+)
**Charging:** 120 kW DC (CCS2) + 22 kW AC (Type 2)
**Cost:** Free for hotel guests (valet charging)
**Rooftop parking:** Yes — covered, secure, valet-managed

Hong Kong's highest hotel (floors 102-118 of the ICC) also has the **best EV charging facilities** of any hotel in the city. The Ritz-Carlton installed a DC fast charger in their valet-operated basement car park — a rarity for Hong Kong hotels where AC charging is the norm.

**What makes it #1:**
- **120 kW DC fast charging** — fully charges a 77 kWh battery (Tesla Model Y LR) from 10% in about 35 minutes
- **Professional valet charging service** — hand your keys to the valet, specify your departure time, and your car is fully charged and waiting
- **Backup AC chargers** — 2 x 22 kW Type 2 for plug-in hybrids or overnight top-ups
- **No additional cost** — charging is included in your room rate (except for non-guests at HKD 80/hr)
- **Location advantage** — direct access to Route 3 for New Territories drives, Austin Road for Kowloon, and West Harbour Tunnel for Hong Kong Island

**The downside:** Room rates start from HKD 5,000+/night, and the valet charging requires booking in advance (limited to 4 EV slots).

**Best for:** Luxury travellers who want the best charging in the city with 5-star service.

---

### 2. The Murray Hong Kong ⭐ 9.3/10

**Location:** Central (Cotton Tree Drive)
**Charging:** 100 kW DC (CCS2) + 22 kW AC (Type 2)
**Cost:** Free for hotel guests

Hong Kong's most iconic heritage-to-modern hotel conversion (former Government Headquarters, reimagined by Norman Foster) pairs landmark architecture with practical EV infrastructure. The Murray was an early adopter, installing a 100 kW DC charger in 2024 and upgrading it in early 2026.

**What sets it apart:**
- **100 kW DC fast charger** — handles most EVs from 20% to 80% in under 30 minutes
- **Concierge EV assistance** — the front desk team is trained on EV charging (unique among Hong Kong hotels)
- **Central location** — perfect for business travellers attending meetings in Admiralty, Central, or Wan Chai
- **Charging included** in your room rate (no sneaky surcharges)

**The downside:** Only one DC charger (shared between guests). The hotel has waiting times on weekend peak periods. Book your charging slot at check-in.

**Best for:** Business travellers and couples wanting a design-forward stay with reliable EV charging in Central.

👉 [Book The Murray Hong Kong on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/index.html?aid=2875669&city=4000101&nflt=ht_id=204&sb=1)

---

### 3. Four Seasons Hong Kong ⭐ 9.2/10

**Location:** Central (IFC, connected to IFC Mall)
**Charging:** 120 kW DC (CCS2) + 22 kW AC (Type 2)
**Cost:** Free with valet service (tip expected)

As expected from a Four Seasons, the EV charging experience is seamless. The hotel operates a **concierge-managed charging service** — you never touch the cable. Drop your keys, and your car is charged and ready when you return.

**Highlights:**
- **120 kW DC — best in Central** — faster than most public chargers on Hong Kong Island
- **Valet charging service** — spotless, professional, with written pre-conditioning notes (battery temp management for fast charging)
- **Connected to IFC Mall** — walk to 120+ shops, HK Station (Airport Express), and the MTR while your car charges
- **Family-friendly layout** — the car park has wide EV-only bays suitable for SUVs (Tesla Model X, Hyundai Ioniq 5)

**The downside:** Rates start from HKD 6,000+/night. The valet EV service is popular — request it when booking your room.

**Best for:** Ultra-luxury family stays and travellers who want zero-effort EV charging.

👉 [Book Four Seasons Hong Kong on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/index.html?aid=2875669&city=4000101&nflt=ht_id=204&sb=1)

### 4. W Hong Kong ⭐ 9.0/10

**Location:** Tsim Sha Tsui (connected to ELEMENTS mall)
**Charging:** 150 kW DC (CCS2, Tesla compatible)
**Cost:** Free for guests (valet charging)

W Hong Kong has the **fastest hotel EV charger in Hong Kong** — a staggering 150 kW DC unit in their valet-operated car park. This is faster than most public charging stations in the city and can add 200+ km of range in 15 minutes.

**Why it stands out:**
- **150 kW DC — fastest hotel charger in HK** — fully charges even a long-range EV in under 30 minutes
- **ELEMENTS mall parking connection** — dozens of additional AC chargers in the mall car park (free with shopping)
- **Lively atmosphere** — W Hong Kong's pool, bar, and restaurant scene makes it popular with younger travellers
- **Kowloon station access** — 3-minute walk to Airport Express and Tung Chung/MTR lines

**The downside:** Only valet parking (no self-park). The hotel's central TST location means navigating Nathan Road traffic to reach the driveway.

**Best for:** Design-conscious travellers and young families who want the fastest charging in town.

👉 [Book W Hong Kong on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/index.html?aid=2875669&city=4000101&nflt=ht_id=204&sb=1)

### 5. The Upper House ⭐ 8.8/10

**Location:** Admiralty (Pacific Place)
**Charging:** 4 x 22 kW AC (Type 2)
**Cost:** Free for guests

Hong Kong's most awarded boutique hotel (every Virtuoso/Forbes award you can name) manages EV charging with Japanese-style thoughtfulness. The Upper House has **four Type 2 AC chargers** in the Pacific Place car park, reserved exclusively for hotel guests.

**Why it ranks high:**
- **4 AC chargers** — the most EV charging bays of any Hong Kong hotel in this list
- **Pacific Place connected** — direct access to Hong Kong's premier shopping mall (charge while you shop)
- **Generous EV bay spacing** — wide bays designed for EV driver door clearance (rare in HK)
- **No booking needed** — just park and plug (but they're first-come, first-served)

**The downside:** AC only (22 kW). Overnight charging is ideal, but in-and-out guests won't get a quick top-up like at DC-equipped hotels.

**Best for:** Boutique hotel lovers and family travellers who want multiple charging options at a luxury price point.

👉 [Book The Upper House on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/index.html?aid=2875669&city=4000101&nflt=ht_id=204&sb=1)

### 6. Grand Hyatt Hong Kong ⭐ 8.5/10

**Location:** Wan Chai (Harbour Road)
**Charging:** 22 kW AC (Type 2)
**Cost:** HKD 50/hr

A convention and business hotel powerhouse, Grand Hyatt Hong Kong rolled out EV charging across their multi-level car park in 2025. The 22 kW AC chargers handle overnight top-ups comfortably.

**What works:**
- **Reliable AC charging** — the chargers are maintained and less frequently ICE'd than public stations
- **Grand Hyatt service levels** — parking attendants monitor the EV bays and will move non-EV cars
- **Harbour-facing location** — walk to HKCEC, Admiralty, and the Wan Chai waterfront
- **5-minute walk to Exhibition Centre MTR** — stay connected if you're commuting

**The downside:** Paid charging (HKD 50/hr) and only AC speed. For a quick top-up between meetings, you'll be disappointed. Overnight? No problem.

**Best for:** Business travellers attending HKCEC events and guests who park overnight.

👉 [Book Grand Hyatt Hong Kong on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/index.html?aid=2875669&city=4000101&nflt=ht_id=204&sb=1)

### 7. Kerry Hotel Hong Kong ⭐ 8.3/10

**Location:** Hung Hom (Harbour-side)
**Charging:** 6 x 22 kW AC (Type 2)
**Cost:** Free for guests

Kerry Hotel Hung Hom leads the **family-friendly EV category**. With six AC charging bays — the most of any Hong Kong hotel by sheer bay count — and a wide, uncrowded car park (rare for Hong Kong), this is the safest bet if you're worried about finding an available charger.

**Strengths:**
- **6 AC charging bays** — best availability in Hong Kong
- **Wide, easy-access car park** — no tight spiral ramps, plenty of room for SUVs
- **Family-friendly hotel** — outdoor pool, kids club, Harbour View Grill, and Hung Hom Promenade walk
- **Connected to Whampoa** — walk to Whampoa Garden for dining and shopping while your car charges

**The downside:** AC only (22 kW). For a 2026 road trip in a Hyundai Ioniq 6 (77 kWh), a full charge takes about 3.5 hours from empty — not a problem overnight, but not a quick turnaround.

**Best for:** Families with young kids and anyone who prioritises guaranteed charging availability.

👉 [Book Kerry Hotel Hong Kong on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/index.html?aid=2875669&city=4000101&nflt=ht_id=204&sb=1)

### 8. Rosewood Hong Kong ⭐ 8.2/10

**Location:** Tsim Sha Tsui (Victoria Dockside)
**Charging:** 90 kW DC (CCS2) + 22 kW AC (Type 2)
**Cost:** Free with valet charging

Rosewood Hong Kong rose rapidly to become one of Asia's most acclaimed hotels, and its EV infrastructure reflects the brand's attention to detail. The 90 kW DC charger complements the AC option for flexible charging.

**Notable features:**
- **90 kW DC charging** — among the fastest hotel chargers on the Kowloon side
- **Stunning harbour backdrop** — the valet waiting area overlooks Victoria Harbour
- **Integrated with K11 MUSEA** — one of HK's most Instagrammable malls, with additional AC chargers
- **Premium service** — Rosewood's butler-level service extends to EV charging (they'll pre-book your charging slot)

**The downside:** Valet-only, and the DC charger is shared between guest rooms and the Rosewood Residences. Weekend availability can be tight.

**Best for:** Couples and luxury travellers wanting Kowloon side access with fast DC charging.

👉 [Book Rosewood Hong Kong on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/index.html?aid=2875669&city=4000101&nflt=ht_id=204&sb=1)

---

### 9. Hotel ICON ⭐ 8.0/10

**Location:** Tsim Sha Tsui East
The **Charging:** 22 kW AC (Type 2)
**Cost:** Free for guests

Hotel ICON — operated by the Hong Kong Polytechnic University's School of Hotel and Tourism Management — punches above its weight. Despite being a mid-range 4-star hotel, it offers **free AC charging** with no limit on charging time.

**Why it's on this list:**
- **Free AC charging** — no hourly fees, no minimum stay
- **Close to Hung Hom MTR and East Rail Line** — ideal for guests arriving from Shenzhen or the New Territories
- **Design-forward on a budget** — room rates 60-70% lower than comparable TST luxury hotels
- **Wide car park bays** — easier to park and plug than in Central/Wan Chai hotels

**The downside:** 22 kW AC (no DC fast charging). 3-4 hours for a full top-up from low battery. Plan an overnight stay.

**Best for:** Budget-conscious EV travellers, visiting academics attending PolyU, and guests arriving via the East Rail Line (Lo Wu/Shenzhen).

👉 [Book Hotel ICON on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/index.html?aid=2875669&city=4000101&nflt=ht_id=204&sb=1)

---

### 10. Holiday Inn Golden Mile ⭐ 7.5/10

**Location:** Tsim Sha Tsui (Nathan Road)
**Charging:** 7 kW AC (Type 2, single-phase)
**Cost:** Free for guests

An unexpected inclusion, but the Holiday Inn Golden Mile on Nathan Road offers **free, no-frills AC charging** for guests — a rarity for budget-tier hotels in Hong Kong. The 7 kW single-phase charger is slow, but if you're staying overnight and just need a full battery by morning, it does the job.

**What it offers:**
- **Free EV charging** at the most affordable hotel on this list (rates from HKD 800-1,500/night)
- **Central TST location** — walking distance to the Star Ferry, Harbour City, Avenue of Stars
- **24-hour parking access** — plug in and leave your car; the multi-storey car park has 24/7 attendant

**The downside:** Single 7 kW charger — you'll need ~11 hours for a full charge from 20% on a 77 kWh battery. First-come, first-served with only one EV bay. Call ahead to reserve.

**Best for:** Budget travellers and short overnight stays where you won't be driving during the day.

👉 [Book Holiday Inn Golden Mile on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/index.html?aid=2875669&city=4000101&nflt=ht_id=204&sb=1)

## Hong Kong EV Hotel Charging: What You Need to Know

### 1. Call Ahead to Confirm Charging

This is the #1 rule for Hong Kong. Unlike Thailand or Malaysia where hotel chargers are plentiful, Hong Kong hotel charging bays are limited (typically 1-4 per hotel). **Always confirm EV parking availability when booking your room.**

### 2. Know Your Charger Compatibility

Hong Kong uses **Type 2 (Mennekes) AC** and **CCS2 DC** connectors — the same as Europe. If you're driving a Japanese import (Nissan Sakura, Mitsubishi Minicab MiEV with CHAdeMO), you'll need a **CCS2-to-CHAdeMO adapter** for DC charging at hotels.

👉 [Get a CCS2-to-CHAdeMO Adapter on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/?tag=familytravel0d-20)

### 3. Self-Park vs Valet Charging

| Charging Style | Hotels | Pros | Cons |
|---------------|--------|------|------|
| **Self-park** | Upper House, Kerry, Holiday Inn | Control over connection, no wait | Must handle cables yourself |
| **Valet charging** | Ritz-Carlton, Four Seasons, Rosewood, W | Service, battery preconditioning | Must request in advance, tip expected |

### 4. Hotel Charging vs Public Charging in Hong Kong

Public charging in Hong Kong is reasonably priced (HKD 2-4/kWh for DC, HKD 1.5-2.5/kWh for AC) but **availability during peak hours** (6-9 PM in residential areas, 10 AM-2 PM in business districts) is a real issue. Hotel parking and charging eliminates this anxiety entirely — your car charges overnight while you sleep.

### 5. Driving in Hong Kong with an EV

| Factor | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| First Registration Tax Waiver | 100% waiver on first registration tax for EVs (extended through 2026) |
| Parking | Hotel parking typically costs HKD 50-80/hr for non-guests; free for guests |
| Tolls | All HKSAR toll tunnels and roads are EV-friendly (no emissions surcharges) |
| Crossing to China | EVs can cross the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge (check cross-border EV permits) |
